profesionales.subtitulo: Defined identity, consolidated career, personal vision.
profesionales.descripcion: Bring everything you've built into one profile — career history, networks, portfolio, collaborations. Be found in the directory where the industry looks for talent and use it as a reference point to find teams, expand your network and be visible to the next generation looking for industry leaders.

emergente.subtitulo: Own projects, creative direction in the making.
emergente.descripcion: The directory where the industry discovers new talent. Bring your first projects together in one profile — portfolio, history, networks, collaborations — and let them find you. Connect with other creatives, expand your network and reach the agencies and brands you need to take the next step.

estudiantes.subtitulo: In training or recently graduated, looking for your place in the industry.
estudiantes.descripcion: Publish your first projects and let the industry discover you. See how creatives who are already where you want to be present themselves, get inspired and build your own profile with what you have now. Your THEFOLDER profile is everything you need to professionalise your portfolio and CV — and present yourself to the industry without distractions.
